_comment: Orkeon Code on a model of this machine: Ollama (https://ollama.com) serving Qwen, no API key, nothing leaving the machine. Copy it to config/appsettings.local.json (ignored by git), or pass it with --settings. Pull the model first: ollama pull qwen3.5:2b (2.7 GB; the AvailableModels are other Qwen that /model switches to, each pulled the same way). Orkeon recognises Ollama by its port, 11434, and asks it for no key, so no ApiKeyEnvVar. Ollama serves every model with a window of 4,096 tokens unless its environment says otherwise, and Orkeon does not widen it per request: the system prompt of a turn is about 2,250 tokens before the tool schemas and the conversation, so set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384 on the Ollama service (systemd: a drop-in under /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/, then daemon-reload and restart), or the model silently loses its instructions and its tools. Temperature 0.6 is Qwen's own recommendation for its reasoning mode: near-greedy sampling makes it repeat itself; Thinking: { Enabled: false } in Llm turns the reasoning off, for faster turns and less sure tool calls. Speech stays on this machine too, through the environment, nothing to add here: ORKEON_CODE_AUDIO_DIR=<folder> declares the Whisper server of mcp/whisper (WHISPER_DEVICE=cuda WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE=float16 WHISPER_MODEL=turbo on an NVIDIA GPU, ORKEON_CODE_VOICE=1 for /voice and /say); config/appsettings.whisper.example.json declares it by hand instead. The other sections are those of config/appsettings.example.json; every key is explained in docs/configuration.md.
